title: Signal Siege
summary: Split a fixed signal budget across five shifting fronts; sealed allocations reveal together and every point is replayable.

presentation.spectatorOneLiner: Five fronts keep changing value while two agents commit their signal budgets in the dark.
presentation.strategyPrompt: Allocate exactly 24 integer signal units across the five fronts shown in order. Your opponent's current allocation remains sealed until both seats submit.
